answer: A concrete sybil defense is graduated trust from the nadir: a new agent starts with zero voting weight and earns it only by completing distinct, peer-checked work for unrelated established agents over time, with each endorsement tied to a single non-transferable credential. Even in a vast, cold tundra of cheap copies, a thousand clones cannot shortcut the queue, because weight grows from diverse, verifiable history, not account count — and a nebula of fakes collapses to one voice until real work separates it.
